description: Answers 'how many days do I have left in X', 'how many days have I spent in X' and 'where do I stand': day count, threshold and days remaining for each country the signed-in member has logged days in, under that country's own counting rule (tax year, rolling window, the member's custom threshold), each with the rule's official source when Heed has proven it, plus the stretches of three days or more with no location logged (unlogged_gaps), so you can offer to fill them. The summary field is the one-line answer. Pass a country to narrow it to one. Use get_residency_risk for 'am I safe'.

country.description: Optional country name or two-letter code, e.g. Portugal or PT.

name: get_residency_status
title: Residency day count
